title: The community chip
summary: Learners' designs side by side in one real Tiny Tapeout tile: see the shared chip, add your own design, and download the whole chip ready for a shuttle.

the chips that come back are tested on the bench against their simulation
shared masks and open tools are what make a community chip possible

learn.plain: Making the masks for a chip costs far too much for one small design, so designs share: many people's circuits are printed side by side on the same chip, and each pays a small share. This page goes one step further: many learners' tiny designs share a single slot of a shared chip, and a little switch on the chip chooses which design is speaking. Like a building of small flats, it puts many homes on one plot of land.
learn.engineer: The community project is one Tiny Tapeout 1x1 tile with every contributed design instantiated in parallel: all designs see ui_in, and a 5-bit selector on uio_in[4:0] drives a case statement that routes the chosen design's outputs to uo_out (up to 32 designs; clocked ones share clk and rst_n). Designs are validated from community/*/design.json by scripts/community.mjs: parse, specification check where a studio project is named, synthesis, placement and routing, and a 150-cell cap per design within a 900-cell budget. CI simulates the generated top level with Icarus Verilog (every design selected in turn, clocked designs from reset) and synthesizes it with Yosys. Submission to a shuttle, and who pays for the tile, is a maintainer decision.

quiz.q: How can many designs share one tile and still be tested one at a time?
options: Each design gets its own pins
A selector chooses which design drives the outputs
quiz.why: All designs receive the inputs; the selector on spare pins picks whose outputs reach the chip's output pins.

quiz.q: Why do shared shuttles make chips affordable for learners?
options: Everyone on the shuttle shares one set of masks and one run through the fab
quiz.why: A mask set costs hundreds of thousands of dollars or more; split across many designs, each pays a small share.
